items.headline: Anthropic's IPO raises over $81bn, the largest on record
items.summary: Shares priced at $83 ahead of today's Nasdaq debut, topping SpaceX's offering for the biggest listing ever and putting the Claude maker near a trillion-dollar valuation.

items.headline: What the Anthropic listing means for the AI race
items.summary: CNN frames the debut as a new chapter for AI, with public investors now able to back a frontier lab directly and scrutiny of its huge compute commitments set to intensify.

items.headline: Quiet morning in space news
items.summary: No major new launches or discoveries surfaced in the last 24 hours that this run could verify; the Vulcan failure investigation and Hera's survey of Didymos (covered yesterday) remain the stories to watch.

items.headline: Tonight in Cavan: mixed, look for clear breaks after dark
items.summary: This run couldn't pull a fresh Met Éireann sky forecast, so treat this as unverified; the cold, showery pattern of recent days means clear spells between showers are likely. A waxing gibbous Moon is bright and sets after midnight, so the darkest skies come late; proper darkness from about 18:00. Verdict: mixed, best window after Moonset.

items.headline: GTA 6 is out and critics love it: 99 on Metacritic
items.summary: Rockstar's game went live overnight on PS5 and Xbox Series X/S and has landed a 99 Metascore with no mixed or negative reviews, tying the all-time record.

items.headline: Launch-night reaction matches the hype
items.summary: Players around the world dived in at midnight, with early impressions as glowing as the reviews; there's still no PC date.

items.headline: Novigrad recreated inside Cyberpunk 2077
items.summary: A project porting a playable chunk of The Witcher 3's Novigrad into Night City is now available, a neat crossover for fans of both CD Projekt games. Nothing new officially on Witcher 4, Cyberpunk 2 or Borderlands.

items.headline: Polaris 40 Saturday: Tonon vs McNally rematch
items.summary: Still the week's big grappling event: Garry Tonon faces Sam McNally for the Polaris lightweight title in Southampton. Otherwise a quiet week for results.

items.headline: UFC Qatar media day done: Hooker and Ortega talk
items.summary: Media day in Doha featured Dan Hooker and Brian Ortega ahead of their co-feature, with Prochazka vs unbeaten Navajo Stirling headlining Saturday. No Irish or UK fighters on the card.

items.headline: Card adds a late newcomer bout
items.summary: The UFC slotted an extra debutant matchup onto the Qatar card days out from the event.

items.headline: Drivers wary of 'insane' wet Vegas practice
items.summary: With a storm forecast for the opening day, drivers expect a slippery, low-grip challenge on cold tyres around the Strip if FP1 and FP2 run in the wet.

items.headline: Vegas preview: schedule and what's still at stake
items.summary: Both titles are settled, so the weekend is about the close scrap for runner-up and third in the constructors'. Quiet on the GT and endurance front.
